name: Gavriel
problem_solved: Inventory-heavy resellers lose hours manually photographing, describing and publishing each unique item. Gavriel automates the listing workflow.
ideal_customer: Resale and second-hand businesses with large, unique, constantly changing inventory.
listing_workflow: Photograph item → Gavriel auto-generates descriptions and listing attributes → publish across channels.
inventory_use_cases: Hundreds of individually listed unique products
proof_demonstration: Demonstration showing AI generating listings from a photo in seconds.
